conbody.p: The USB charger allows drivers and passengers to charge their digital devices such as smartphones and tablets.

li.p: The battery charging state may be monitored on the electronic device.
Disconnect the USB cable from the USB port after use.
Fast charging is available on the electronic device equipped with fast charging capabilities. The device without fast charging is charged at a regular speed.
Fast charging may not work when the electronic devices are off.
Charging some digital devices is not available or requires special dedicated adapters if their charging methods don't fit the way the USB car charger works.
Do not attempt to use the charging terminal either to turn on an audio or to play media with the infotainment system.
Charging speeds may vary depending on the state of charging status of electronic devices.
